notes.title: Giveaway Keys & Updates
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

I'm currently working on several corrections as I've seen that some of you have for example subtitles issues. I'll find out what it is about and work that out.

I also wanted to point that some of you received Giveaway keys from partners on the web or on social media. The key allows you to access Episode 0 which is already free but above all [b]you can access Episode 1 & 2[/b]!

All you need to do is [b]copy-paste your key[/b] in the profile area and puf! [b]Free Access Granted[/b]. Nothing more needed. You will have in the future the possibility to link to an email or whatever.

If you didn't get a giveaway key, you can for a limited time unlock these episodes by typing "ABCDE-Got-My-Eps".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42387527/4ab67f45a09709aa47b9a52f91db9af3181c7cf5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42387527/53aedda658c62a981e9a158927ae7c57acfe0aee.png[/img]

I hope you'll enjoy the episodes. Also, if you consider buying the full Vol.1 (Episode 0 to 8), [b]maybe you should wait few days ;)[/b]

See you soon for the next update!
AxelG

Edit 6/23/22: [i]Just updated the app. The subtitles problem should be solved. I'll be working on the unMatched Mode and Extra features.[/i]
